nodes.name: Webhook - Get Contract Public
nodes.notes: Public — no auth. Access is controlled entirely by the unguessable public_token, same trust model as the proposal magic-link flow.

parameters.query:
SELECT ct.id, ct.title, resolve_product_tokens(ct.content_html, false) AS content_html, ct.total_amount, ct.status, ct.public_token, ct.signature_name, ct.signature_email, ct.signature_date, ct.signature_data, ct.pdf_base64, ct.signed_at, ct.field_values,
  o.name AS opportunity_name, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email AS contact_email,
  u.name AS owner_name, u.email AS owner_email, u.phone AS owner_phone,
  cp.company_name,
  ct.thank_you_page_id, resolve_product_tokens(tp.content_html, false) AS thank_you_page_content_html,
  dp.public_token AS down_payment_token, dp.total AS down_payment_amount,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.invoice_id = dp.id AND p.status = 'succeeded') AS down_payment_paid,
  ct.cosigned_at, u2.name AS cosigned_by_name
FROM (SELECT $1::text AS tok) dummy
LEFT JOIN contracts ct ON ct.public_token::text = dummy.tok
LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.id = ct.opportunity_id
LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.id = o.contact_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.assigned_user
LEFT JOIN users u2 ON u2.id = ct.cosigned_by
LEFT JOIN company_profile cp ON cp.id = 1
LEFT JOIN pages tp ON tp.id = ct.thank_you_page_id
LEFT JOIN invoices dp ON dp.opportunity_id = ct.opportunity_id AND dp.invoice_type = 'down_payment';

parameters.query:
SELECT ct.id, ct.opportunity_id, ct.flow_id, ct.status, ct.public_token, ct.total_amount, o.contact_id, f.contract_signed_stage_id,
  o.name AS deal_name,
  c.email, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.unsubscribe_token,

  p.line_items AS proposal_line_items, p.total_amount AS proposal_total_amount
FROM (SELECT $1::text AS tok) dummy
LEFT JOIN contracts ct ON ct.public_token::text = dummy.tok
LEFT JOIN deal_document_flows f ON f.id = ct.flow_id
LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.id = ct.opportunity_id
LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.id = o.contact_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.assigned_user
LEFT JOIN proposals p ON p.id = ct.proposal_id;

UPDATE contracts SET status = 'signed', signature_name = $1, signature_email = $2, signature_date = $3::date, signature_data = $4, signed_at = now(), field_values = $6::jsonb, signature_ip = $7
WHERE id = $5 AND status != 'signed';

parameters.query:
SELECT ct.id, ct.opportunity_id, o.name AS opportunity_name, ct.proposal_id, ct.flow_id, ct.public_token, ct.title, ct.content_html, ct.total_amount, ct.email_subject, ct.email_body, ct.status, ct.signature_name, ct.signed_at, ct.created_at, ct.sent_at,
  CASE WHEN $2 = 'admin' THEN ct.signature_ip ELSE NULL END AS signature_ip
FROM contracts ct
JOIN opportunities o ON o.id = ct.opportunity_id
WHERE ct.is_archived = false AND ($1::int IS NULL OR ct.opportunity_id = $1) AND ($2 = 'admin' OR o.assigned_user = $3)
ORDER BY ct.created_at DESC;
SELECT assigned_user, pipeline_id, stage_id FROM opportunities WHERE id = $1;

SELECT f.id
FROM (SELECT 1) dummy
LEFT JOIN deal_document_flows f ON f.is_active = true AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM stages s WHERE s.id = f.trigger_stage_id AND s.pipeline_id = $1
)
ORDER BY (f.trigger_stage_id = $2) DESC, f.id NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Look Up Matching Flow (Save)
nodes.notes: Manually-created contracts (Documents page, deal card quick-create) had no flow_id at all before this, so signing one could never move the deal stage — this links it to whichever active flow belongs to the deal's pipeline, same matching used for proposals.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO contracts (id, opportunity_id, flow_id, title, content_html, total_amount, email_subject, email_body, status, created_by, created_at, sent_at)
VALUES (COALESCE($1, nextval(pg_get_serial_sequence('contracts', 'id'))), $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, 'draft', $9, now(), NULL)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  title = EXCLUDED.title,
  content_html = EXCLUDED.content_html,
  total_amount = EXCLUDED.total_amount,
  email_subject = EXCLUDED.email_subject,
  email_body = EXCLUDED.email_body,
  flow_id = EXCLUDED.flow_id
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Upsert Contract
nodes.notes: Only touches status on INSERT (new contracts start as 'draft') — the ON CONFLICT UPDATE branch omits status entirely, so editing an already-sent or signed contract's content never resets its progress.

parameters.query:
SELECT ct.id AS contract_id, ct.public_token, resolve_product_tokens(ct.email_subject, true) AS email_subject, resolve_product_tokens(ct.email_body, true) AS email_body, ct.opportunity_id,
  o.assigned_user, o.name AS deal_name, o.deal_value, o.created_at AS deal_created_at, o.expected_close AS deal_due_at,
  c.id AS contact_id, c.email, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.unsubscribe_token, c.phone, c.city, c.state,
  co.name AS client_company_name,
  u.name AS owner_name, u.email AS owner_email, u.phone AS owner_phone, (SELECT company_name FROM company_profile LIMIT 1) AS our_company_name,
  (SELECT i.total FROM invoices i WHERE i.opportunity_id = o.id AND i.invoice_type = 'down_payment' ORDER BY i.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS down_payment_amount,
  (SELECT pay.created_at FROM payments pay JOIN invoices i ON i.id = pay.invoice_id WHERE i.opportunity_id = o.id AND i.invoice_type = 'down_payment' AND pay.status = 'paid' ORDER BY pay.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS down_payment_paid_at,
  (SELECT i.total FROM invoices i WHERE i.opportunity_id = o.id AND i.invoice_type = 'final' ORDER BY i.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS balance_amount,
  (SELECT pay.created_at FROM payments pay JOIN invoices i ON i.id = pay.invoice_id WHERE i.opportunity_id = o.id AND i.invoice_type = 'final' AND pay.status = 'paid' ORDER BY pay.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS balance_paid_at
FROM (SELECT $1::int AS cid) dummy
LEFT JOIN contracts ct ON ct.id = dummy.cid
LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.id = ct.opportunity_id
LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.id = o.contact_id
LEFT JOIN companies co ON co.id = c.account_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.assigned_user;
